caseName: V. Dhanapal Chettiar v. Yesodai Ammal
summary: Eviction procedures, security deposit refund obligations, and tenant protections.
keyHoldings: A landlord cannot evict a tenant or withhold possession without obtaining a valid order under the relevant Rent Control Act. Arbitrary retention of security deposit without lawful cause is illegal.

summary: Unregistered rental agreements and validity of month-to-month tenancy.
keyHoldings: Even if a lease deed is unregistered, the relationship of landlord and tenant is created by payment and acceptance of rent, granting the tenant legal protections against forcible eviction.
